common_space: same prepared X and IDs for all K and methods within each variant; scores across different variants are not a quality ranking

preprocessing.constant_scale: fail explicit; no block silently dropped
preprocessing.robust_scale: sqrt(median all unordered pair squared distances) per block; organization coordinates first divided by IQR; median centering; NumPy linear quantiles
preprocessing.actual_fit_X_raw: byte-frozen source X_raw, not reconstructed replacement

Ward.cut: cut_tree(n_clusters=[K]); same full tree for every K within variant

KMeans.iteration_cap: attempt not eligible if n_iter>=300; no automatic extension
KMeans.representative: min sklearn inertia among valid attempts; exact ties canonical labels then seed index

metrics.SW: sklearn silhouette_samples exact all points Euclidean common X
metrics.inertia: sum squared distances to canonical-label mean centers; not a K-selection criterion

profiles.units: raw measured values; typical RUB=geometric mean of all12months; closed shape only selected5, not all Total
profiles.medoid: min sum of within-cluster Euclidean distances; exact tie lexical ID
profiles.centroid_representative: closest observed ID to group mean; exact tie lexical ID
profiles.boundary_order: lowest pointwise SW then lexical ID

crosswalk.Ward: strict nested cuts, validated per child
crosswalk.KMeans: overlap counts/Jaccard/ARI only, no subtype/lineage claim
crosswalk.across_spaces: same IDs matched partition overlap only, no cross-space SW ranking

selection.requires: separate substantive profile review and draw robustness track
selection.tiny_groups: retained and exposed, not automatically rejected

robustness_interface.indices: unique sorted integer source row indices; subsample without replacement; bootstrap duplicates explicitly rejected by this API

budget.outer_supervisor: root generic probe must guard full preparation and execution too

input_gate: root-accepted sealed corrected input; r00 is staging, not launch authorization
input_metadata_source: approved r01 exact 35-member source; no input Python or bytecode imported

operational_amendment.reason: root resource lease: CPU7 only, one worker; no scientific change
